text:
mia: FYI SkyBridge reported a ~$6.5k misbill from last month. they say several customers show duplicated usage spanning midnight cutover windows. tagging partnerships + ops.

samir: timeline? sounds like boundary windowing issue (UTC vs partner local tz) + our hourly bucketing.

yoko: pulled sample: partner sends minute deltas in local TZ (UTC+2). our marketplace ingest normalizes to UTC but the partner's connector sometimes labels window_end as local midnight leading to a split hour that gets double-counted when we re-bucket.

lee: do we have concrete repro steps? can we map raw events -> post-rollup rows?

mia: yes, repro for two customers: minute deltas 23:55-00:05 local got assigned to both 21:00-22:00 UTC and 22:00-23:00 UTC depending on arrival ordering and daylight savings flag. net effect: +100-250 tokens duplicated per customer.

samir: immediate mitigation: add a normalization pass in ingestion that rejects events with timezone-ambiguous window_end (no TZ offset header) and mark them "tz-ambiguous" for manual review. gate auto-apply for partners with >0.2% ambiguous events over 24h.

yoko: long-term: require partner connectors to include ISO8601 offset on window timestamps (e.g., 2026-03-28T00:00:00+02:00). if not present, infer from partner profile timezone but only apply after a reconciliation dry-run.

recon-bot: created ticket PRJ-9955 "skybridge-tz-ambiguous-duplicate-usage" assigned to @yoko. (https://redwood.atlassian.com/PRJ-9955) :robot_face:

yoko: proposed playbook:
- run dry-run re-bucket for affected invoice periods to compute per-customer duplicate delta
- produce CSV for partner sign-off
- apply compensating ledger adjustments (via ledger-service compensations API) after legal ok
- enable ingestion guardrail for tz-ambiguous events

lee: estimated scope from quick sample: ~420 impacted hour-windows across 58 customers; ledger delta est ~$6.2k. compute job should be light (~0.05 batch-hours).

mia: owners/ETAs:
- yoko: open PR for tz-ambiguous flag + dry-run job (ETA 2 days)
- samir: add ingestion guardrail + alert rule (ETA 1 day)
- lee: generate partner CSV and ledger delta estimate (ETA 1 day)
- mia: draft partner comms + legal path (ETA 1 day)

samir: unit tests for re-bucketing logic and DST edgecases required. i'll pair with yoko.

mia: scheduling quick sync with SkyBridge tomorrow 8:30am PT to walk them through the ask. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
